purpose: AI-generated promotional artwork for the repository, using a maintainer-supplied real Sticky photo as hardware reference. Not a substitute for physical-device test evidence.

prompts.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: wide GitHub README hero banner, 16:9 landscape, high resolution. Create a polished editorial product image for the open source firmware repository CrossNext for Sticky. Input image 1 is a hardware and screen appearance reference: faithfully preserve this specific white Seeed reTerminal Sticky e-paper device's proportions, broad white bezel, slim rectangular body and real grayscale reading-shelf interface. Remove the hand, steering wheel, car interior and background; stage the device upright on the right half on a warm ivory paper studio surface, soft natural shadows and a subtle sage-green circle behind it. Do not add hardware buttons to the front or invent a glowing LCD screen. Device should be large, elegant and convincing; its real reading-shelf layout remains visible, without inventing new app screens. Left half has beautiful spacious typography. Text verbatim: 'CrossNext' as the largest heading, 'for reTerminal Sticky' underneath, and 'Read. Study. Play.' as a smaller line. Bottom left a small restrained badge reading 'OPEN SOURCE FIRMWARE'. Black typography, subtle forest-green accents, matte paper texture, refined contemporary publishing design, excellent spacing and clean edges. No invented logo, no Seeed endorsement badge, no version number, no watermark. This is promotional artwork, not documentary evidence. Deliver one finished banner, not a collage of variants.

Below, a spacious row of three equal feature cards with thin black borders and beautiful simple monochrome pixel-inspired illustrations (a book, a small stack of flashcards, and a chess knight); these are decorative feature illustrations, not app screenshots. Exact headings and text: card 1 'READ' and 'EPUB · TXT · Markdown · XTC'; card 2 'STUDY' and 'Flashcards · Vocabulary · Dictionary'; card 3 'PLAY' and 'Games · Virtual pet · Tools'. A small carefully reproduced device from the reference may sit near the upper right as a supporting visual without crowding title. Preserve the reference screen appearance if included; no fake feature screens, no invented logo. Strong visual hierarchy, generous margins, accurate diacritics, legible typography, no extra text or watermark.
